name: smwgraphics-actraiser-fillmore-act
title: ActRaiser - Fillmore (Act 1)
description:
Part of the forest seen in the first action stage of ActRaiser. The complete tilemap is quite a nightmare to assemble, so I had to adapt it to fit with SMW standards. It's a quite big background, surprisingly.

I added some extra map 16 tiles to help users to vary the background a tiny bit. Its height is easy to adjust and it can even fit vertically scroll enabled levels.

A good fit for forests. Even spooky ones, perhaps.
